headline: Meta launches Enterprise Platform and hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai; ESA Juice completes Earth flyby toward Jupiter; Artemis Accords pass 75 signatories.

stories.title: Meta launches Enterprise Platform; MongoDB CEO Desai jumps to lead it
facts: Meta (Mon): Mark Zuckerberg announces Meta Enterprise Platform as a “next major pillar” — packaging Muse agent, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code and more for businesses/developers.
Chirantan “CJ” Desai joins Meta as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, reporting to Zuckerberg; he steps down immediately as MongoDB President & CEO.

MongoDB primary: Board installs former CEO Dev Ittycheria (2014–2025) as interim President & CEO; permanent search begun; company reaffirms Q3 / FY2027 guidance from Sep 1; Investor Day Tue Sep 29 at Nasdaq.

THE DECODER / WSJ context: Meta is spending >$100B on AI infrastructure this year; enterprise lineup still lacks public pricing/how-it-works detail — faces Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and cheap open-weight rivals.
stories.whyItMatters: Meta is productizing Muse into a billed enterprise stack and poaching a sitting database CEO to run it — the clearest signal yet that ads-plus-infra alone won’t fund the AI buildout.

image.alt: Meta header graphic for Enterprise Platform announcement

stories.title: ESA Juice skims Earth, slingshots toward Jupiter
facts: ESA (Mon): Juice’s closest approach 13:45 CEST — ~8,640 km over the Indian Ocean; gravity assist deflected the path by ~20° and added ~3.5 km/s with almost no propellant.
Ops: only one tiny pre-flyby nudge used of six reserved opportunities; Angela Dietz says the propellant saved is banked for icy-moon observation time at Jupiter.

Science: instruments calibrated again (third real-surface chance after 2024 lunar-Earth assist and 2025 3I/ATLAS); magnetotail pass coordinated with Smile; JANUS Earth/Moon images expected in coming weeks.
Roadmap: one more Earth flyby in Jan 2029, then Jupiter arrival 2031 — 35 moon flybys before a Ganymede orbit.
stories.whyItMatters: Today’s Earth skim is the big mid-cruise course correction — fuel saved now buys observation time at Europa/Ganymede later.

image.alt: Juice monitoring-camera view of Earth during the September 2026 flyby

stories.title: Artemis Accords clear 75 nations as four more sign
facts: NASA (Mon): Albania, Croatia, Côte d’Ivoire and San Marino join — total now 76 signatories (~40% of UN members).
Administrator Jared Isaacman: nearly one-third of all signatories have joined since the start of President Trump’s current term; Accords group meets twice yearly under the 2024 Method of Operations.
Next: Principals’ Meeting at IAC Antalya beginning Mon Oct 5, co-chaired by NASA Deputy Admin Matt Anderson and Peru’s CONIDA.
stories.whyItMatters: Civil lunar norms keep expanding as a soft coalition — useful context for Moon Base payload invites even when hard hardware news is quiet.

image.alt: Signing ceremony as San Marino joins the Artemis Accords

facts.text: heise / T&E: battery e-trucks already cheaper to run than diesel on 5-year TCO in 6 of 9 EU markets — DE up to ~€85k advantage; DE toll exemption to mid-2031 cited as a big lever; H1’26 EU e-truck share still only 4.8%.
Al Arabiya (state media, Mon): Iran’s UNGA delegation in New York says it has no plans for further US talks — material chill vs this morning’s “Trump expects Iran talks this week” framing.
PetaPixel: Italian politician sparks AI scandal with a doctored photo that “undressed” a female lawmaker — another generative-image abuse flashpoint in EU politics.
The AI Corner: argues OpenAI’s Greg Brockman shifted ~25% of production engineers toward defense work after an “AGI era” framing — tip, not a company primary.
HN tip — Alex Ewerlöf: “Coding Is Not Solved” — pushback on the idea that AI coding agents close the software problem.
Playwright merged PR #42968: MCP `browser_find` can save results to a file — small but useful agent tooling tweak (no new release tag).

BVB (ad-hoc / dpa): Cramer named Vorsitzender der Geschäftsführung (was Sprecher); contract to 30 Jun 2031; Ricken (Sport) to 30 Jun 2030; Treß extends one year to 30 Jun 2028 then exits GF; Schlenker unchanged to 2028.

Warriors Media Day follow: Curry (via NBC Sports / Heavy) says knee feels great after managed offseason — “ready to go”; still expects selective rest on back-to-backs; Hawai’i camp practices start Tue Sep 29.
